name: Ahrefs MCP
summary: Ahrefs MCP is Ahrefs' own hosted MCP server. It gives your agent the Ahrefs API, including a Search Console tool group, on paid Ahrefs plans.
signIn: OAuth consent screen, which creates an API key with MCP scope in the Ahrefs account. A manually generated MCP key can be sent as a Bearer token. Enterprise customers can also use API keys.
tools: No count stated. The Tool Categories page lists 20 tool groups, including a gsc group.
dataSources: Google Search Console: keywords, pages, positions and performance history
free: No. MCP is on paid plans starting from Lite. Ahrefs Free and Starter do not appear in the MCP plan list.
price: Lite $129 per month, Standard $249 per month, Advanced $449 per month, Enterprise $1,499 per month with an annual commitment. Paying annually saves up to 17%. Prices in USD. MCP calls use API units: 200,000 on Lite, 800,000 on Standard, 2M on Advanced, custom on Enterprise.
writeActions: No Google Search Console write actions stated. A management tool group handles Ahrefs projects, keyword lists, locations and Brand Radar configuration.
history: Search Console performance history is offered, length not stated. Ahrefs historical data is 6 months on Lite, 2 years on Standard, 5 years on Advanced and unlimited on Enterprise.
pickIf: You already pay for Ahrefs and want its full backlink, keyword and rank tracking data in your agent.
You want to choose which Ahrefs tool groups your agent sees, for clients that limit how many tools they load.
You build in Copilot Studio or n8n, which Ahrefs has setup guides for.

sources.fact: Hosted server, Lite and up, sign in, clients, API units
Tool groups including gsc and management
Plan prices, API and MCP access, historical data
